input.state: sampleId (nonempty ≤150 chars), revision (integer 0..100000000), selected (0..2), channels in order CH1,CH2,CH3
input.channels: id, setV (0..6/25/25 V), limitA (0..10/2/2 A), enabled, connected, loadOhm (0..1e7 Ω), leadOhm (0..100 Ω round trip, equal split), remote, senseIntact; flags boolean. No shared return or chassis earth implied.

outputs.bts.dc-supply-run.v1: Each contact has regulation status, terminalV, loadV (null when physically open), meterV, currentA, supplyW, loadW, leadW; parentRevision and result revision=input revision+1; source config preserved.
outputs.csv: One row per contact, comment header with sample ID, revision and simulated origin; unconnected load volts blank.
outputs.bts.analog-waveform.v1: sampleId, revision, startS=0, dtS=0.1, channels[{id:'CHn_LOAD-HI_to_LOAD-LO',unit:'V',samples:161 values}], provenance with source settings and three steady-state input stages. Sample t in seconds from sequence start; volts of load HI relative to its own LO; no physical time-response claim.

failures: invalid load-bank schema/ID, range or unit
open remote sense pair or missing load in remote mode
remote correction above 1 V per lead or conservative terminal headroom
load-step export requires enabled, connected positive resistance
